note: All data is synthetic, for teaching. Item IDs are what the prototype reports.

form.member_id.requirement: Corvus member ID is filled in and legible, and identifies exactly one ClaimCore member (obvious typos and legacy Helix IDs are fine if the name and date of birth confirm the member)

form.hospital_id.requirement: Hospital network ID is filled in

form.doctor_name.requirement: Treating doctor's name is filled in

form.doctor_reg_no.requirement: Treating doctor's medical council registration number is filled in

form.diagnosis.requirement: Provisional diagnosis is filled in and legible

form.icd10.requirement: ICD-10 code is filled in and consistent with the diagnosis and the proposed treatment

form.admission_date.requirement: Date of admission is filled in

form.length_of_stay.requirement: Expected length of stay (days) is filled in

form.estimated_cost.requirement: Estimated total cost is filled in

form.patient_signature.requirement: Patient has signed (an attendant may sign for an emergency admission)

doc.id_card.requirement: Corvus e-card (or legacy insurer card) or government photo ID, in the patient's own name

doc.clinical_note.requirement: Planned: consultation note dated within 30 days before admission. Emergency: admission note

doc.cost_estimate.requirement: Cost estimate on hospital letterhead, signed by the hospital, total within 10% of the form

doc.biometry.requirement: Biometry report (A-scan or optical) with the IOL power, for the eye being operated on

estimate.iol_details.requirement: Cost estimate lists the lens (IOL) type and its cost

doc.xray_knee.requirement: X-ray report of the knee being operated on, dated within 90 days before admission

doc.conservative_treatment.requirement: A separate record of at least 6 weeks of conservative treatment (physiotherapy or medicines). A mention in the consultation note is not enough

estimate.implant_details.requirement: Cost estimate lists the implant and its cost

doc.abdominal_imaging.requirement: The ultrasound or CT report of the abdomen itself, supporting the diagnosis

doc.antenatal_record.requirement: A separate antenatal record (card) showing LMP and EDD. The obstetric note alone is not enough

note.lscs_indication.requirement: Caesarean only: the medical reason for the caesarean is stated in the obstetric note

doc.ecg.requirement: The ECG report itself (a mention in the note is not enough)

doc.angiography.requirement: The coronary angiography report itself, naming the vessel and the % narrowing (a mention in the note is not enough)

estimate.stent_details.requirement: Cost estimate lists the stent(s) and their cost
